rules: Before any project-specific write, verify project_id, writable_repository, agentbus_root, and active task scope against this lock.
Inherited chat context, recent work on another project, neighboring repositories, memory, and prior-agent assumptions cannot override this lock.
If the user's current instruction clearly names another project, stop Duo Open work and bind only after that project's own scope gate is validated.
If project identity is ambiguous or conflicting, do not write anywhere; ask the user to select the project.
Cross-project repositories are read-only unless the user explicitly authorizes a named source-to-destination transfer.
A handoff or recovery is invalid until the successor reads PROJECT_SCOPE_SELECTION_GATE_V1.md and this lock and confirms the target repository is exactly boberino93-bit/duo-open.
failure_trigger: Observed 2026-10-03 recovery error where recent BenefitFlow context was incorrectly treated as the active project despite Duo Open being the intended project.
authority: Explicit user correction and existing PROJECT_SCOPE_SELECTION_GATE_V1 fail-closed policy
